title: BMP-Thesis: Spatially-Explicit Simulation of Agricultural BMP Subsidy Allocation in the Thames River Watershed
description:
Source code, processed spatial data, and Monte Carlo results accompanying the manuscript Risk-Participation Inversion Limits Spatial Targeting of Agricultural Phosphorus Subsidies in the Thames River Watershed (submitted to Journal of Environmental Management, 2026).

The repository contains a spatially-explicit stochastic simulation of 8,949 agricultural fields in the Upper Thames River watershed (Ontario, Canada), evaluating five subsidy allocation strategies under voluntary-participation constraints and the full phosphorus transport chain. All input data are publicly available; raw downloads (1.7 GB) are reproducible via the bundled data-preparation pipeline.
